decision.rationale: TXN-007912 (6967 minor units EUR, Quayside Outfitters MER-000006, on card CRD-000149) posted on 2026-07-30. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-23, 85 days later. That is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000017 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-08-06. The dispute was opened 78 days after that date, so the 15-day waiting period in goods-not-received-wait has passed. No carrier delivery confirmation is attached, so nothing shows delivery to the cardholder. The cardholder's email DOC-000018 of 2026-08-15 shows they asked the merchant about the order and got no reply. The ledger has no refund from this merchant on the card. Under goods-not-received-merchant-evidence, the next step is to ask the merchant for proof of delivery. This category does not allow a provisional credit.

proposed_actions.note: For the order placed on 2026-07-29 for 69.67 EUR, please provide the carrier's delivery record showing delivery to the cardholder's address, signed for by the cardholder.
